Hey ،That's Me :)

My name is Soroush Saki, born in 2001 and for as long as I can remember, I’ve been fascinated by computers spending countless hours exploring their mysterious world.
Over time, I grew tired of using them in the usual way and started searching for something more.
Then one day, as a kid, I built a PowerPoint slide that could switch between pages with a click and suddenly, something clicked inside me too.
That was the first time I felt the joy of creating, not just using.
In 2012, when I was 11 years old, I stumbled upon the world of programming, and though I didn’t know it yet, that simple moment quietly changed the direction of my life.

Stock Price Scraper Using Python

This project demonstrates how to scrape live stock prices from a financial website using Python libraries like requests, BeautifulSoup, and pandas. The scraped data is saved to a CSV file for further analysis.

UsedCar Market Data Analysis

Hospital Database Management System

The Hospital Database Management System (DBMS) is a sophisticated SQL project developed to improve the organization and efficiency of hospital operations. It is designed to offer a user-friendly solution for storing, accessing, and managing different types of healthcare data effectively.
